title: The Arbiter of Law Left Chaos in His Wake

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A Sun Empire warrior and planeswalker who captures Angrath, allies with Tishana and fights over the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Angrath
entities.description: A minotaur planeswalker with white-hot chains who breaks free of Huatli's dinosaur and joins the fight for the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Tishana
entities.description: A River Herald elder who leads her clan to Orazca and fights Vona for the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Kumena
entities.description: A River Herald thrown from Orazca's tower and saved by Tishana's wind.

entities.name: Vona of Iedo
entities.description: A vampire conquistador who uses the Immortal Sun to torment her enemies.

entities.name: Breeches
entities.description: A goblin pirate of the Belligerent who leaps onto Vona's face.

entities.name: Malcolm
entities.description: A siren pirate of the Belligerent whose song entrances those in the Sun chamber.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A telepath and Living Guildpact who shields Vraska and passes judgment on Azor.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker and captain who confronts Azor and learns the Immortal Sun imprisons planeswalkers.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: A sphinx planeswalker and creator of the Ravnican guilds who helped build the Immortal Sun, gave up his spark, and is sentenced by Jace.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The enemy Azor's plan was meant to imprison; Vraska's employer.

entities.name: Alhammarret
entities.description: The sphinx whose teachings Jace remembers.

entities.name: Emperor Apatzec
entities.description: The Sun Empire's emperor whose army Huatli senses just beyond the city.

entities.name: Elder Dinosaurs
entities.description: Five ancient, untamable great dinosaurs that awaken with Orazca and answer Huatli's call.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: A disk embedded in Orazca that amplifies the magic of whoever touches it and prevents planeswalkers from leaving a plane, built by Azor to imprison an enemy.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The awakened golden city with the Immortal Sun in its central tower.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane where Azor settled and the Immortal Sun sits.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane whose guild system Azor built.

entities.name: Useless Island
entities.description: The island Jace sentences Azor to as master and caretaker.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: The continent where a monastery first received the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild of law led by Azor as parun.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: The vampire conquistadors who seize the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The dinosaur-riding empire Azor once gave the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: The merfolk whom Azor deemed unworthy of the Immortal Sun.

events.summary: Huatli's summoned dinosaur bowls Angrath over and pins him.
events.quote: then effortlessly bowled him over and trapped him underfoot.

events.summary: Tishana arrives with her clan and confirms her agreement with Huatli stands.
events.quote: I assembled my clan. Our agreement stands.

events.summary: Huatli leaves Angrath under the dinosaur and goes with Tishana.
events.quote: Angrath, I'm sorry, but I need to go with Tishana. We had a deal first.

events.summary: Huatli and Tishana enter Orazca and see a dark storm rising from its tower.
events.quote: after some time, Huatli blinked sweat from her eyes as she passed through the gate of the golden city.

events.summary: Kumena falls from the tower and Tishana's wind breaks his fall.
events.quote: The body's descent slowed and then stopped altogether as a massive gust of wind rose up to break the fall

events.summary: Huatli concludes the Legion of Dusk has taken control of the Immortal Sun and the city.
events.quote: the Legion of Dusk had taken control of the Immortal Sun

events.summary: Tishana proposes they take the vampires together and resolve ownership afterward.
events.quote: We can take them together,

events.summary: Breeches charges the tower shouting for the Sun while Malcolm flies above.
events.quote: WE WANT SUN! WE WANT SUN!

events.summary: Huatli and Tishana burst into the Sun chamber and Vona claims the Immortal Sun for the Legion of Dusk.
events.quote: I am Vona, Butcher of Magan, and the Immortal Sun belongs to the Legion of Dusk!

events.summary: Huatli realizes the Immortal Sun is a disk set into the floor.
events.quote: the disk could only be the Immortal Sun.

events.summary: Tishana's elemental slams into Vona while Huatli takes on the hierophant.
events.quote: Her elemental had grown large once more and barreled into Vona's side as she stood on the Immortal Sun.

events.summary: Vona uses the Immortal Sun to turn Huatli's blood against her.
events.quote: Vona was using the Immortal Sun to manipulate her blood.

events.summary: Malcolm's song enthralls everyone in the chamber until Breeches leaps onto Vona's face.
events.quote: The goblin leaped forward onto Vona's face.

events.summary: Angrath breaks down the doors, having burned through the dinosaur Huatli left on him.
events.quote: The golden doors to the room were lying flat on the ground, and standing above them, howling in rage, was Angrath.

events.summary: Huatli, Tishana, Angrath and Vona all touch the Immortal Sun and a surge of energy passes through them.
events.quote: The four of them gasped as an immense current of energy passed through them.

events.summary: Through the Sun, Huatli senses the Elder Dinosaurs awaken and calls them to her.
events.quote: She called Elder Dinosaurs to her, and felt the ground tremble as they began to approach.

events.summary: Huatli senses Emperor Apatzec's army at the city's edge, realizing she was not sent alone.
events.quote: she felt the footsteps of Emperor Apatzec's army.

events.summary: Breeches and Malcolm hear Jace and the floor gives way beneath the standoff.
events.quote: Malcolm, you heard Jace too?!

events.summary: Azor greets Vraska and Jace from his throne, asking who they have brought to seal.
events.quote: If this gorgon is not my prisoner, then who have you brought for me to seal?

events.summary: Azor calls the Immortal Sun the lock of his prison and Vraska realizes it is what traps planeswalkers.
events.quote: The lock of my prison, my finest creation.

events.summary: Azor binds Vraska with law magic through Jace's ward, but Jace frees her.
events.quote: A binding of glowing white runic magic grabbed hold of her torso and shoved her back toward the door behind them.

events.summary: Azor boasts of imposing stability on worlds for thousands of years.
events.quote: I used hieromancy to give these people the gift of stability

events.summary: Azor admits he left Ravnica when he finished and Jace admits he has not upheld his duties as Guildpact.
events.quote: Because Ravnica was one of many, and I left when I was finished.

events.summary: Azor reveals the Immortal Sun imprisons planeswalkers and that he gave up his spark to make it.
events.quote: I gave up my spark to help create the Immortal Sun, the lock of my prison, my greatest gift to all living things.

events.summary: Azor explains the failed plan with a friend to lure a foe to Ixalan.
events.quote: He was to lure our foe to a faraway plane and I was to use the Immortal Sun to enhance my hieromancy and summon that foe here, to Ixalan.

events.summary: Azor explains he gave the Immortal Sun to a monastery in Torrezon and then to others who proved unworthy.
events.quote: I initially gifted it to a monastery in the east, in Torrezon.

events.summary: Azor attacks Vraska and Jace; Vraska cuts his leg.
events.quote: Vraska unsheathed her sword and cut a long thin line across Azor's back leg.

events.summary: Jace attacks Azor's mind with a migraine.
events.quote: manipulate Azor's mind, sending the feeling of a piercing migraine through the sphinx's head.

events.summary: Vraska accuses Azor of causing centuries of war and her own suffering.
events.quote: The Immortal Sun has spawned hundreds of years of conflict on this plane,

events.summary: Jace takes responsibility to judge Azor as Living Guildpact.
events.quote: It is my responsibility to act on behalf of Ravnica.

events.summary: Azor reveals the plan was to imprison Nicol Bolas, and Jace remembers him.
events.quote: Our intention was to imprison Nicol Bolas

events.summary: Jace sentences Azor to be the caretaker of Useless Island, never to leave or meddle again.
events.quote: You will be the master and caretaker of Useless Island.

events.summary: Azor flies away, leaving the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: He beat them, rose into the air, and flew out the door Vraska and Jace had entered through without another word.

events.summary: Vraska asks why Bolas wants a planeswalker prison and Jace says she needs to know who she works for.
events.quote: you need to know who you're working for.

relations.note: They agree to take the vampires together.
Azor helped build the Immortal Sun as a prison.
relations.quote: I gave up my spark to help create the Immortal Sun, the lock of my prison, my greatest gift to all living things.

relations.note: Azor was parun of the Azorius.
relations.quote: The Living Guildpact stared at the parun of the Azorius

relations.note: Azor's plan aimed to imprison Bolas.
relations.quote: Our intention was to imprison Nicol Bolas

relations.note: Jace tells Vraska she works for Bolas.
relations.quote: you need to know who you're working for.
Vraska felt Jace's magic countering the grip of Azor's hieromancy.

relations.note: Angrath targets Vona with his chains.
relations.quote: Angrath aimed his white-hot chains at Vona.
